steps.note: Start an eRFX draft creation flow.
Enable eRFX project creation as required by the case.
Apply the required tenant configuration that prevents vendor addition during creation.
Apply the required tenant configuration for stage handling.
Provide the mandatory draft title.
Apply the first available template so savings and line items can be configured.
Add a line item required for the draft's pricing and savings configuration.
Complete the pricing sheet for the line item.
Commit a valid schedule before saving the draft.
Save the configured eRFX as a draft.
Confirm the draft save did not show an application error.
Navigate to the events list to reopen the saved draft.
Open the Drafts tab specified by the case.
Verify the plan's saved draft appears in Drafts.
Reopen the draft created by this plan.
Open the Savings Calculation window.
Verify the Savings Calculation window opened.
Open the custom reference input.
Enter the requested custom reference; this field label is inferred because the catalog does not specify it.
Save the custom reference.
Verify the Savings Calculation window closes after saving.
Reopen the draft's savings section to verify persistence.
Confirm the savings section is open for the saved draft.
Verify the saved custom reference is displayed in the draft's savings section.
